briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 escalate frontier race as multi-agent deployments surge

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies with major model releases and infrastructure investments dominating Q3 2026. US and Chinese labs push boundaries while regulatory scrutiny grows. Global compute capacity expands rapidly amid geopolitical tensions.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus. DeepSeek-V4 and xAI Grok-3 close capability gaps. Meta open-sources Llama 4 weights.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 1M units monthly. Microsoft and Google announce $40B combined data center expansions in Texas and Arizona. TSMC 2nm AI chips enter volume production.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models from Meta and DeepSeek overtake closed frontier systems by end of 2027?
